in_sanskrit.name: कुरुवा
in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of Fortune, prosperity, and wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: कु (kū) - black, dark, or deep, रु (ru) - flow, current, or move, वा (vā) - mother or goddess. Therefore, Kuruva could be the goddess of the flow of wealth, prosperity, and abundance, or the mother who nurtures and provides wealth and prosperity.

in_hindi.name: कुरुवा
in_hindi.meaning: कुरु (kuru) - do, make, or perform, वा (vā) - mother or goddess. Therefore, Kuruva could be the mother who performs or creates something, or a goddess who makes or creates something beneficial.

in_tamil.name: குருவா
in_tamil.long_meaning: கு (ku) - teacher or wise one, ரு (ru) - flow, வா (vā) - mother or goddess. Therefore, Kuruva could be the goddess of the flow of knowledge and wisdom, or the mother who imparts knowledge and wisdom.

in_telugu.name: కురువ
in_telugu.meaning: Goddess of the flow of prosperity and abundance
in_telugu.long_meaning: కు (ku) - black, dark, or deep, రు (ru) - flow, வ (v) - mother or goddess. Therefore, Kuruva could be the goddess of the flow of prosperity and abundance, or the mother who nurtures and provides prosperity and abundance.

in_marathi.name: Kuruva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuruva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kuruva is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kruvā' meaning 'moon' or 'moonlight'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is associated with peace, tranquility, and femininity.

in_bengali.name: Kuruva
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kuruva একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Kuruva is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kruvā' meaning 'moon' or 'moonlight'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is associated with peace, tranquility, and femininity.
